name: summary_report
query:
SELECT

    r.user_name AS "Resident:Data:180",
    r.resident_id AS "Resident ID:Data:120",

    a.apartment_name AS "Apartment:Data:180",
    a.place AS "Place:Data:150",

    p.problem_id AS "Problem ID:Data:120",
    p.problem AS "Problem:Data:250",
    p.category AS "Category:Data:120",
    p.status AS "Problem Status:Data:120",

    ta.technicians AS "Assigned Technician:Data:180",
    ta.status AS "Faculty Status:Data:120",
    ta.priority AS "Priority:Data:100",

    t.category AS "Technician Category:Data:120",
    t.phone AS "Technician Phone:Data:120"

FROM `tabResident` r

LEFT JOIN `tabapartment_details` a
ON a.name=r.apartment_name

LEFT JOIN `tabproblems` p
ON p.parent=r.name

LEFT JOIN `tabTASK-ASSIGN` ta
ON ta.problem_id=p.problem_id

LEFT JOIN `tabTechnician` t
ON t.name=ta.technicians

ORDER BY
r.user_name;
